tools.name: search_roles
tools.description: Search open senior roles (Manager to C-suite) at the 500 largest US companies by words, seniority band, function, work mode, region, city or state, minimum salary and recency. Returns up to 25 roles a page with title, level, location, posted pay range, date and a link. Use it for "VP finance roles i

tools.name: get_role
tools.description: One role by id (the number at the end of its URL): title, level, function, location, work mode, posted pay, date, industry, a short redacted summary and scope, plus four similar open roles. Use it after search_roles when the user wants more on one result. Limitation: the company, full description an

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: The job functions, seniority bands, industries, top cities and work modes you can filter search_roles by, each with its count of open roles. Use it to resolve a function name or to answer "how many open VP roles are there". Returns no roles.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Connector-style search over open senior roles. Returns ids for fetch. Prefer search_roles when you can filter.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Connector-style fetch of one role by the id from search. Same fields as get_role.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
